scope: Seven independently compared native bodies, including all 65536 uint16 event values for the two entry filters and 192 explicit dynamic-type creation/boundary cases, with query, target, attachment, control, ability and legacy-creation callbacks substituted; no composed gameplay or UI claim. Three native private entries and two callback adapters use regparm(3). Allocated bounded records/type indices and ordinary storage are modeled. Child callbacks may mutate globals, counts, records, target definitions, type data and type-table pointers. Callback-boundary state and compound arguments are summarized with 32-bit hashes; final fixture snapshots are byte compared. Ten additional functions change only masked local identifiers and are verified by exact source and expanded-token projections, without claiming new native cases for them.
status: Application-time snapshot: native comparisons and actual compiler-unit checks pass. Subsequent build/setup completion is published in aura-attachment-cleanup-coverage.json.
